Quick analysis from the logs:
- Account creation windows: 2027-05-03 to 2027-06-08 (clusters around 2027-05-04 and 2027-06-02).
- IP overlap: 3 accounts resolve to the same /24; 2 additional accounts use cloud-hosted IPs but share billing contact by email.
- Payment/billing: all on free tier so no card token linkage, but the billing contact field is identical across three accounts.

Interpretation: likely coordinated internal teams spinning up separate sandboxes to test — but the repeated receipt of promotional vouchers looks like an attempt to multiply free usage rather than a single consolidated pilot. That triggers our promo policy threshold.

My recommendation:
1) Rescind the most recent voucher grants for the duplicate accounts (hold credits, not the accounts).
2) Offer Orchard Tech a consolidated pilot account (single org) and transfer remaining credits if they verify a primary admin and procurement contact.
3) Temporarily block further promo issuance to orchardtech.com pending verification.
